_comment: Trace Bloom design tokens. JSON so BOTH Jekyll (_data/preview/design) and the Node renderer (scripts/preview/) read the same file — see docs/PREVIEW-IMAGES.md and docs/TRACE-BLOOM.md. Editing a palette here re-skins every regenerated banner.

type.mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

_comment_safe: SAFE BAND. The theme renders cards as background-size:cover at 120-150px (home/cover.html), so a 3:2 banner is centre-cropped to as narrow as 2.5:1 — only the middle 60% of the height survives. og:image (1.91:1) keeps ~78%. Every glyph must sit inside safeTop..safeBottom or it is cut off in the grid. scripts/ci/lint_preview.rb enforces this.
_comment_bounds: Closed parameter space: the algorithm may only wander inside these ranges, because every seed in them was swept for a usable frame. See TRACE-BLOOM.md 'the parameter space must be closed'.
